statement: 0x80 gain signedness discrepancy: SDL Triton haptic rumble declares signed 8-bit gain for each motor, Linux declares u8 for the same byte positions. Both consume 0x00..0x7f identically; negative/dB semantics beyond sources are No evidence. SDL structs:162-173, driver:595-624.
